title: N. Mock pages
description: The pages of the product's mock-up: a static frontend under `mock/`, one HTML page per screen, on JSON fixtures and no backend. What the factory view shows on its easel, and what the gates check every screen has.

title.description: What a human calls it in the list of pages.

objective.description: The user goal the page serves — the sentence the page was created from.

screen.description: The frozen screen composition this page mocks (`apps/screens/<screen>.json`), once it exists.

components.description: The Micro-UIs the page shows; each is marked `data-component="<MicroUi>"` on its root element in the page.
